title: Do two sentences mean the same?
intro: You will see two sentences. Say whether Sentence 2 means the same as Sentence 1.
Answer from the words only. Use 'unsure' if you really cannot decide.

help.text: Same if a listener would understand the same thing from both. Different if the listener would understand something else, even if the wording is close.
Contractions (I am / I'm), word order that does not change who does what, and similar style differences do not make a difference.

q1.title: Same meaning?
q1.text: Do the two sentences tell the listener the same thing: who does what to whom, whether it is so or not, when it happens, how sure the speaker is, and whether it is a statement, a question or a request? Small differences in wording or style do not count.

blocks.label: Sentence 1
blocks.text: I will go to the shop.

blocks.label: Sentence 2
blocks.text: I will not go to the shop.

practice.fb: The second sentence says the opposite (not going), so they are different.

blocks.label: Sentence 1
blocks.text: It is raining now.

blocks.label: Sentence 2
blocks.text: It's raining now.

practice.fb: Only the contraction differs, so they mean the same.
